Trivy Security Scanner GitHub Actions Breached, 75 Tags Hijacked to Steal CI/CD Secrets


Mar 20, 17:47


Trivy, a popular open-source vulnerability scanner maintained by Aqua Security, was compromised for the second time in a month to deliver malware that steals sensitive CI/CD secrets. The attack targeted GitHub Actions "aquasecurity/trivy-action" and "aquasecurity/setup-trivy," which are widely used to scan Docker container images for vulnerabilities in CI/CD pipelines. This represents a significant supply chain attack affecting organizations that rely on Trivy for container security scanning.


Direct threat to your CI/CD pipeline security and container vulnerability management - rotate secrets immediately if using affected Trivy actions


Sources: The Hacker News · Ars Technica

Mar 20, 20:45


The FBI issued a public service announcement warning that Russian intelligence-linked threat actors are actively targeting users of encrypted messaging apps such as Signal and WhatsApp in phishing campaigns that have compromised thousands of accounts. The attackers bypass Signal's robust end-to-end encryption by hijacking user accounts through sophisticated phishing techniques. The campaign specifically targets high-value individuals and demonstrates nation-state efforts to circumvent secure communications.


Nation-state targeting of secure communication platforms affecting your organization's executive communication security and threat modeling


Sources: BleepingComputer · Cybersecurity News

Mar 20, 18:48


Oracle released an out-of-band security update to fix a critical unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-21992) in Identity Manager and Web Services Manager with a CVSS score of 9.8. Attackers can execute arbitrary code without authentication if Oracle's Identity or Web Services Managers are exposed to the web. The vulnerability affects two widely deployed Fusion Middleware components used in enterprise identity management systems.


Critical threat to your identity management infrastructure requiring immediate patching of Oracle Fusion Middleware components
